McpServerDefinition.description: The same two governed Apex actions the Experience Cloud workspace agent uses: resolve a contract and its Box documents, then ask Box AI about one. Box credentials stay in Apex, so a client reads contract content without ever holding a Box token.

tools.descriptionOverride: Finds a CLM contract from the reference a person used, its governed Box folder, and every document with its Box file ID. Call before asking about any document: it is the only source of file IDs.
Asks Box AI about one contract document by its Box file ID, or across a Box Hub such as the approved clause library by passing its Hub ID with itemType hub. The answer quotes that content.
tools.toolTitle: Ask Box AI About a Contract Document
